design: Battery backpack V2 rev M (minimal), printable frame and cap, both Orange. Only the battery is new: the 2S 3000 mAh pack (74 x 34 x 20 envelope) stands upright, leads up, 6.3 mm right of centre in the rev B column; the lower tier ends at z -46 so the seated robot keeps 10 mm or more under the backpack; nothing grows above z 43 or wider than |y| 32.05. What the robot has today moves in unchanged: the Swann 39 rocker switch on its switch lead (plug 1 takes the battery's XT30), the DFR1202 taped to the column's left rib as in rev B, and the servo XT30 and A7Z MR30 swap leads out of the lower left. The switch sits in the cap's upper left with its rocker facing back (8 mm behind the cap, above the flight harness). The battery's white 3-pin balance plug rests in an open-top notch at the cap's upper right; charging is switch off and that plug into the HTRC B3, with nothing opened or unplugged. No Pololu, XIAO, LED button, contact pads, diode or dock. The cap is a back plate over both tiers held by two M2 x 8 (high) and two M2 x 6 (low); the frame screws onto the OpenRB pack posts with the four M2 x 6 as today. No snaps, hooks, flexures or latches of ours.

Shawn then deferred the dock ('对准以后再说'), corrected that the white plug meant the battery's own 3-pin balance plug ('不是不是 你完全误解了 我说的把白色头是电池上的3针头'), and asked for the minimal change above; the coordinator relayed '重做背包' with the scope: rev B frame and cap, new electronics left out, the switch and DFR1202 moved in, the balance plug reachable through the cap. Rev M follows that; its changes from rev B are in build_v2.py's docstring and features.json (removed features with reasons). The rocker standing 8 mm behind the cap replaces rev B's 'nothing grows behind x -75.55' (P-ENV rev 2): the switch has no other place in this outline.
